source_policy: No data cleaning, rewriting, filtering, or repartitioning; reuse existing exact context and v2 tree/entity indexes
exposure: Both datasets and the rejected four v3 conditions are known. This revision removes the rejected solver/output extensions; no new accuracy result has been measured.
selection: all19 math and all125 Multi-Document QA; report every outcome, no question-level routing or favorable subset selection
reference_policy: Use v2 final generation prompts, formats and limits. Historical predictions are immutable. Exact request caches require matching deployment and payload; no per-question or dataset-based solver routing.

comparison_boundary.knowledge_tools: Same five v2 tools; no calculator
comparison_boundary.stopping: v2 source-available answer action and model reflection; no task classification or mandatory abstention
comparison_boundary.final_generation: Unchanged v2 raw final prompts: MATH4096 and LongBench128 with original grammar
comparison_boundary.review: No final-answer review or partial-field recovery
remaining_changes: constraint-preserving request identity and query anchoring
comparison_boundary.resource_limit: Controller token budgets differ from historic default v2; no claim of an isolated accuracy effect or equal total resources.
